summary: GoldMining Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 14, 2026, announcing the appointment of Alexandre Pimenta as Project Director for its 100%-owned São Jorge Gold Project in Pará State, Brazil. The operational hire is not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board departure that constitutes a special situation. The release states pre-feasibility activities are commencing and an infill diamond drilling program is in final preparation, building on a June 11, 2026 PEA contemplating a 5,500 tpd open-pit operation over a 10.6-year mine life. No deal terms were disclosed; watch project advancement news.
